newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says low rates contributing to recovery.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says low rates contributing to recovery.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Thursday that Japan's current low interest rate policy was contributing to its economic recovery and creating a favourable environment for people's living standards.

Hashimoto, speaking at the plenary session of the Lower House of parliament, said that he understood that people depending on interest income were facing difficulties from low interest rates amid generally stable prices.
"On the other hand, the current low interest rate policy is contributing to economic recovery and is creating a favourable environment for people's livelihoods," Hashimoto said.

Asked whether the Bank of Japan (BOJ) will be pressured to change its monetary policy as a result of the government putting a priority on fiscal restructuring, Hashimoto said that it was up to the BOJ to decide monetary policy.
